title: P1: make Light governance routing reachable for evidence-bearing documentation Work Items
outOfScope: release metadata, candidate state, tags, and provider Release publication
unrelated active or archived Work Item evidence
manual governance profile overrides or quality downgrades

sources.reason: Authoritative problem statement and acceptance for evidence-bearing documentation Work Items.
Routing-policy SSOT; its broad .ai/** Strict pattern currently escalates required lifecycle evidence.
Current deterministic classifier and receipt renderer.
Existing routing regression coverage and local policy fixture.
Canonical adopter/maintainer documentation for profile selection and evidence-only behavior.
Canonical downstream generated assessment bound to the changed Capability Truth matrix.
Canonical downstream generated pre-release alignment report bound to the refreshed assessment.

rawUserRequest: Complete the remediation plan through closure. Issue #687 requires Light routing to remain reachable for a documentation-only governed Work Item despite its required lifecycle evidence, without temporary overrides or quality downgrades.

riskAssessment.reason: The change alters automatic quality routing. Incorrect evidence-only matching could hide a Strict operational path or make lifecycle-only diffs an unaudited completion path.

reasons: The Work Item changes routing policy and classifier code, so its own implementation must use Strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized implementation. The policy, classifier, test fixture, and documentation provide bounded, offline evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Review evidence-only patterns narrowly: they must cover only required lifecycle projections and must never take precedence over release-owned paths.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A docs-only Work Item diff combined with the required active Contract, Summary, start receipt, Outcome, Cockpit status/report, and archive projections selects Light and dispatches quality-fast through a deterministic receipt.

Adding any Strict operational path to that evidence-bearing documentation diff selects Strict and dispatches quality-full; release-owned paths and release Contract context remain Strict with release escalations.
Unknown implementation paths retain the policy's conservative Standard-or-Strict default, and an evidence-only diff alone cannot select Light or authorize completion.

The policy explicitly lists the narrowly permitted lifecycle projections, the receipt exposes their evidence-only decisions, and canonical routing documentation explains the boundary without promising a manual downgrade.
Capability Truth, Japanese capability, and pre-release documentation-alignment projections are regenerated through their canonical generator chain after the registered routing evidence changes.
Focused routing tests and the Contract-required verification suite pass with no changes outside declared scope.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The current maximum-risk path classifier promotes ordinary docs-only Work Items to Strict because required Contract/Summary/archive lifecycle paths fall under the broad .ai/** Strict pattern. Light is therefore unreachable in the normal governed lifecycle.
constraints: Treat only explicit required lifecycle projections as evidence-only; do not make .ai/** broadly non-risky.
Preserve Strict precedence for governance implementation, CI, installer, dependency, release, security, migration, and unknown-path policy behavior.
Do not add a manual profile override, bypass ai-finish lifecycle gates, or change Make quality target ownership.
Keep routing deterministic, auditable, and offline-testable.
intent.rationale: Narrow path-level evidence-only classification removes bookkeeping-induced escalation while retaining maximum-risk selection across actual implementation paths. The existing receipt remains the auditable decision surface.

declaredIntent.summary: Make automatic Light routing reachable for documentation-only Work Items while preserving fail-closed governance and release escalation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Documentation implementation plus every allowed lifecycle projection
scenarioCoverage.expected: The deterministic receipt has evidence-only decisions for lifecycle paths, selects Light, and dispatches quality-fast.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: tests/test_governance_profile.py asserts the complete accepted projection list with a documentation path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Documentation implementation plus Strict operational or release path/context
scenarioCoverage.expected: The receipt selects Strict/quality-full; release-owned or release Contract evidence additionally emits release escalations.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: tests/test_governance_profile.py covers a Strict path, release-owned path, and release Contract context combined with lifecycle evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Unknown paths use the configured conservative default, while evidence-only-only diffs remain at least Standard.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user granted automatic execution for every plan Work Item and #687 explicitly authorizes correction of governance routing policy.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item's policy, classifier, tests, and documentation together, restoring the previous conservative routing behavior without rewriting archived evidence.
